instruction: List every name from column B that appears more than once into column D beginning at D2, preserving their first appearance order. Do not alter unrelated cells.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying names that appear more than once in column B and listing them in order of first occurrence. Verified with Python Counter: Keira Daily (2 times), 50 Dollar Dollar (4 times), Jonah Mountain (4 times), Jeff Tunnels (5 times). Emma Stoned and Morgan Prisoner appear only once so excluded. Expected list in cells D2-D5. Evaluator reads D2:D5 and checks against expected list with partial credit for set overlap.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts values from column D range (D2:D5) using openpyxl
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - accesses expected.get('values') directly as the rules dict
Comparison logic is sound: exact match check (order-sensitive) with fallback to set overlap for partial credit
Expected values are semantically correct based on metadata verification (4 names with duplicates identified via Python Counter)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file to ensure state freshness
